description.full_text: The image is an advertisement for an air purifier, prominently featuring the product with digital displays. It highlights its ability to remove formaldehyde and other pollutants, claiming a sales volume of over 400,000 units. There are various discount offers, including prices like 1139 and 1199, and promotions for 88VIP members. A cartoon character wearing a mask suggests health benefits. The overall mood is promotional and informative, emphasizing product efficiency with various statistics and certifications. Numerous logos and icons are present, indicating purchase and delivery options.
